## 🔵 Blue – Personal Identity  
*(Birth, family, gender journey, self-perception)*

- **Birth & Family Background**:  
  - Born September 18, 1987, in Portland, Oregon.  
  - Raised in an unstable environment; father was 17 when she was born, grew up in a group home, and was absent.  
  - Mother, Deanne Hoffer, was a heavy alcoholic and left her at age 12 to care for younger siblings.  
  - Described mother as “not ready to be a mom.”  
  - Mother is intersex with an underdeveloped testicle.  
  - Has two younger brothers and a half-sister.

- **Gender Identity & Evolution**:  
  - Came out as gay at age 13.  
  - In 2017, identified as **non-gendered** or **non-binary**, used singular "they" pronouns.  
  - In 2024, stated she identifies as **trans-femme non-binary** and now uses **she/her pronouns**.  
  - In 2025, identified as **pansexual**.  
  - Began **hormone replacement therapy** and underwent **facial feminization surgery** in 2024.  
  - Drag persona inspired by her mother and comedians like Lucille Ball, Maria Bamford, Sarah Silverman, and Deven Green.

- **Ancestry & Heritage**:  
  - Learned she has **partial Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry** through her maternal grandmother, Judith Irwin-Hoffer.  
  - Grandmother was born to Jewish parents of Polish and Finnish descent and adopted by an Irish Catholic couple.  
  - Uses **Jinkx Monsoon** as a way to connect to her Jewish heritage — describes the character as a “failed Jewish actress who became every gay boy’s favorite cabaret act.”

- **Name Change**:  
  - Legally changed her name to **Hera Hoffer** in April 2024, while keeping her stage name **Jinkx Monsoon**.

## 🔴 Red – Performance  
*(Drag, stage roles, music, comedy, persona development)*

- **Drag Debut & Early Work**:  
  - First performed in drag at age 15 at Escape Nightclub under the name **Heidi Destruction**.  
  - Took stage surname **Monsoon** after Edina Monsoon from *Absolutely Fabulous*.  
  - Created the character **Deirdre A. Irwin**, a Southern medium, which she performs as a separate persona.

- **Drag Race Success**:  
  - Won **Season 5 of RuPaul’s Drag Race (2013)**.  
  - Won **Snatch Game** by impersonating **Edith Bouvier Beale ("Little Edie")**.  
  - Also impersonated **Mimi Imfurst** and **Natasha Lyonne**.  
  - Won **All Stars 7 (2022)** — first two-time winner of the show across global franchises.  
  - Won Snatch Game in All Stars 7 with impressions of **Natasha Lyonne and Judy Garland**.

- **Musical Theatre & Stage Roles**:  
  - Played **Hedwig** in *Hedwig and the Angry Inch* (2013).  
  - Starred as **Angel** in *Rent* (2012).  
  - Played **Velma Von Tussle** in *Hairspray* (2013).  
  - Made **Broadway debut as Mama Morton** in *Chicago* (2023).  
  - Played **Audrey** in *Little Shop of Horrors* (off-Broadway, 2024).
